title: Banks Act Circular C2/2018 — Requirements related to a due diligence audit of the financial condition of a bank
enablingLegislation: Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Introduction 1.1 This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). 1.2 Requirements related to a due diligence audit of the financial condition of a bank. 1.3 This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.

subsections.text: This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990).
Requirements related to a due diligence audit of the financial condition of a bank.
This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: Application 2.1 This circular applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). 2.2 Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein.

subsections.text: This circular applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990).
Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein.

sections.heading: Acknowledgement of receipt
sections.text: Acknowledgement of receipt 3.1 Kindly ensure that a copy of this circular is made available to your institution's auditors. The attached acknowledgement of receipt, duly completed and signed by both the Chief Executive Officer of the institution and the said auditors, must be returned to the PA at the earliest convenience of the aforementioned signatories.
